description: Free on-chain safety check on a Solana SPL token before you buy: reports whether mint authority (dev can print unlimited supply) or freeze authority (dev can freeze your tokens) are still live. Returns CLEAN, RISK, or UNKNOWN (established issuer tokens like USDC are allowlisted). Read-only, no keys.

mint.description: the SPL token mint address to check

name: token_scam_check
